d: Join a fast-paced vehicle testing and mapping operations team supporting innovative automotive and mapping technology projects across major markets in the Middle East.

Drivers will be required to follow pre-assigned routes and testing instructions, operate vehicles for approximately 8 hours daily, and achieve a minimum daily driving target of 200 kilometers, subject to operational and road conditions.
